caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair centered on a plain, light beige background. The chair has a simple, sturdy construction with four straight legs, a flat seat, and a high backrest. The backrest is ornately cut with decorative shapes, including a heart-shaped cutout at the center and rounded elements along its edges. The wood is depicted in shades of brown with visible texture and variation, suggesting the grain and wear of natural wood. There are no additional objects or elements present in the composition, and the scene is depicted with realistic colors and shading. The artist's signature, "Joseph Rettenmayer," is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Side Chair
